labels.quote: Tesla's total revenues increased 18.8% from $81.5 billion in 2022 to $96.8 billion in 2023.
Income from operations fell 34.9% from $13.7 billion in 2022 to $8.9 billion in 2023.
Operating margin was 12.2% in 2023, based on income from operations of $8.9 billion and total revenues of $96.8 billion.
Net income attributable to common stockholders was $15.0 billion in 2023.
